source: User-supplied House Gravenholt character and lore cards; established continuity.

house.name: House Gravenholt
house.sigil: Black badger with extended claws on a bone-colored shield.
house.philosophy: Strong walls matter. Stronger people matter more.

party.name: The Gravenholt Three
party.purpose: A small diplomatic and problem-solving party under Lord Edric's authority.

established_at_opening.friendship: Their friendship predates the opening story.
established_at_opening.shared_life: Shared meals, travel routines and private jokes.
established_at_opening.trust: An unusually high degree of mutual trust; no numerical scores established.
established_at_opening.private_dynamic: Closer to siblings than commander and subordinates. Horace is an older-brother figure, not a father or distant mentor.
established_at_opening.matilda_to_victor: Matilda trusts Victor because he respects her judgment.

private_familiarity.note: They usually think he cannot hear; he generally can.

gifts.item: Broken-back seax refined with subtle southern craftsmanship.
Victor had the grip of Horace's old sword improved.

continuity.first_adventure: Establishes the trio's existing bond; it does not create their friendship from scratch.

romance.opening_state: Long friendship, not an established romantic relationship.
romance.handling: Future authoring continuity, not a past episodic memory or permission to force the player's feelings.
